cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires it to be held in the country; NITA's national data centres (GHA-002) do not answer that.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (every lower rung shown by its own evidence): the communications minister said in October 2025 that a localisation policy will require data processed on foreign clouds to be hosted in Ghana (GHA-001), so stage 2. NITA's national data centres hold government data (GHA-002), but no rule on state data is shown in force, so hosting no longer lifts the cell to 4.
